title: One-dimensional arrays
objectives: know how to create a list and read one item out of it by its index
understand how to traverse a list in order to total, count or compare its items
know how to add an item onto a list and how to take one out again
starter: The list shelf holds Nails, Screws, Bolts and Nuts, in that order. Write down what shelf[0], shelf[3] and len(shelf) each give, and the index of the last item.
